<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;

class AuthController extends Controller
{
    public function login(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $request->validate([
            'email'    => 'required|email',
            'password' => 'required|string',
        ]);

        $user = User::where('email', $request->email)->first();

        if (!$user || !Hash::check($request->password, $user->password_hash)) {
            return response()->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Identifiants invalides.'], 401);
        }

        if (!$user->is_active) {
            return response()->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Compte désactivé.'], 403);
        }

        $employee = $user->employee;
        $token    = $user->createToken($this->parseDevice($request->userAgent() ?? '', $request->ip()))->plainTextToken;

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'data'   => [
                'token'       => $token,
                'user_id'     => $user->id,
                'role'        => $user->role,
                'email'       => $user->email,
                'employee_id' => $employee?->id,
                'full_name'   => $employee ? $employee->first_name . ' ' . $employee->last_name : null,
                'job_title'   => $employee?->job_title,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    private function parseDevice(string $ua, string $ip): string
    {
        $browser = match(true) {
            str_contains($ua, 'Edg')                                  => 'Edge',
            str_contains($ua, 'OPR') || str_contains($ua, 'Opera')   => 'Opera',
            str_contains($ua, 'Firefox')                              => 'Firefox',
            str_contains($ua, 'Chrome')                               => 'Chrome',
            str_contains($ua, 'Safari')                               => 'Safari',
            default                                                   => 'Navigateur',
        };
        $os = match(true) {
            str_contains($ua, 'Android')                              => 'Android',
            str_contains($ua, 'iPhone') || str_contains($ua, 'iPad') => 'iOS',
            str_contains($ua, 'Windows')                              => 'Windows',
            str_contains($ua, 'Macintosh')                            => 'macOS',
            str_contains($ua, 'Linux')                                => 'Linux',
            default                                                   => 'Appareil',
        };
        return "$browser · $os · $ip";
    }

    public function logout(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $request->user()->currentAccessToken()->delete();

        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => ['logged_out' => true]]);
    }

    public function changePassword(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $request->validate([
            'current_password' => 'required|string',
            'new_password'     => 'required|string|min:8',
        ]);

        $user = $request->user();

        if (!Hash::check($request->current_password, $user->password_hash)) {
            return response()->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Mot de passe actuel incorrect.'], 403);
        }

        $user->update(['password_hash' => Hash::make($request->new_password)]);

        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => ['message' => 'Mot de passe mis à jour.']]);
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Department;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

class EmployeeController extends Controller
{
    private function formatEmployee(Employee $emp): array
    {
        $emp->loadMissing(['department', 'user', 'manager']);
        $data = $emp->toArray();
        unset($data['department'], $data['user'], $data['manager']);
        $data['photo_url']       = $emp->photo_path
            ? '/php/hrm-laravel/public/employees/' . $emp->photo_path
            : null;
        $data['department_name'] = $emp->department?->name;
        $data['email']           = $emp->user?->email;
        $data['manager_name']    = $emp->manager
            ? trim($emp->manager->first_name . ' ' . $emp->manager->last_name)
            : null;
        $data['is_active']       = (int) $emp->is_active;
        return $data;
    }

    public function index(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $page    = max(1, (int) $request->query('page', 1));
        $perPage = min(100, max(5, (int) $request->query('per_page', 25)));
        $search  = trim($request->query('search', ''));

        $query = Employee::with(['department', 'user', 'manager']);

        $authUser = $request->user();
        $isEmployee = $authUser->role === 'employee';

        if ($search !== '') {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('first_name', 'like', "%$search%")
                  ->orWhere('last_name', 'like', "%$search%")
                  ->orWhere('employee_number', 'like', "%$search%")
                  ->orWhere('job_title', 'like', "%$search%");
            });
        }

        $total = $query->count();
        $rows  = $query->forPage($page, $perPage)->get()->map(function ($e) use ($isEmployee) {
            $data = $this->formatEmployee($e);
            if ($isEmployee) {
                // Champs publics uniquement pour un employé qui consulte ses collègues
                return array_intersect_key($data, array_flip([
                    'id', 'first_name', 'last_name', 'job_title',
                    'email', 'department_name', 'manager_name', 'photo_url', 'is_active',
                ]));
            }
            return $data;
        });

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'data'   => $rows,
            'meta'   => ['total' => $total, 'page' => $page, 'per_page' => $perPage],
        ]);
    }

    public function show(Request $request, int $id): JsonResponse
    {
        $authUser   = $request->user();
        $emp        = Employee::with(['department', 'user', 'manager'])->findOrFail($id);
        $data       = $this->formatEmployee($emp);

        // Pour un employé ordinaire qui consulte un collègue : champs publics uniquement
        if ($authUser->role === 'employee' && $authUser->employee?->id !== $id) {
            $data = array_intersect_key($data, array_flip([
                'id', 'first_name', 'last_name', 'job_title',
                'email', 'department_name', 'manager_name', 'photo_url', 'is_active',
            ]));
        }

        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => $data]);
    }

    public function subordinates(int $id): JsonResponse
    {
        Employee::findOrFail($id);
        $subs = Employee::with(['department', 'user', 'manager'])
            ->where('manager_id', $id)
            ->get()
            ->map(fn($e) => $this->formatEmployee($e));
        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => $subs]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $request->validate([
            'email'           => 'required|email|unique:user,email',
            'password'        => 'required|string|min:8',
            'role'            => 'required|in:hr,manager,employee',
            'department_id'   => 'required|integer|exists:department,id',
            'employee_number' => 'required|string|max:30|unique:employee,employee_number',
            'first_name'      => 'required|string|max:80',
            'last_name'       => 'required|string|max:80',
            'job_title'       => 'required|string|max:120',
            'hire_date'       => 'required|date',
            'manager_id'      => 'nullable|integer|exists:employee,id',
            'birth_date'      => 'nullable|date',
            'phone'           => 'nullable|string|max:30',
        ]);

        $employee = DB::transaction(function () use ($request) {
            $user = User::create([
                'email'         => $request->email,
                'password_hash' => Hash::make($request->password),
                'role'          => $request->role,
            ]);

            return Employee::create([
                'user_id'         => $user->id,
                'department_id'   => $request->department_id,
                'manager_id'      => $request->manager_id,
                'employee_number' => $request->employee_number,
                'first_name'      => $request->first_name,
                'last_name'       => $request->last_name,
                'job_title'       => $request->job_title,
                'hire_date'       => $request->hire_date,
                'birth_date'      => $request->birth_date,
                'phone'           => $request->phone,
            ]);
        });

        $employee->load(['department', 'user']);
        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => $this->formatEmployee($employee)], 201);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, int $id): JsonResponse
    {
        $employee = Employee::findOrFail($id);

        $request->validate([
            'department_id' => 'required|integer|exists:department,id',
            'first_name'    => 'required|string|max:80',
            'last_name'     => 'required|string|max:80',
            'job_title'     => 'required|string|max:120',
            'manager_id'    => 'nullable|integer|exists:employee,id|not_in:' . $id,
            'birth_date'    => 'nullable|date',
            'phone'         => 'nullable|string|max:30',
        ]);

        $employee->update($request->only(
            'department_id', 'first_name', 'last_name',
            'job_title', 'manager_id', 'birth_date', 'phone'
        ));

        $employee->load(['department', 'user']);
        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => $this->formatEmployee($employee->fresh(['department', 'user']))]);
    }

    public function deactivate(int $id): JsonResponse
    {
        $employee = Employee::with('user')->findOrFail($id);

        // Bloquer si c'est un RH et qu'il n'y a pas d'autre RH actif
        if ($employee->user?->role === 'hr') {
            $otherActiveHr = \App\Models\User::where('role', 'hr')
                ->where('is_active', true)
                ->where('id', '!=', $employee->user->id)
                ->exists();

            if (!$otherActiveHr) {
                return response()->json([
                    'status'  => 'error',
                    'message' => 'Impossible de désactiver le dernier compte RH actif.',
                ], 422);
            }
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($employee) {
            $employee->update(['is_active' => false]);
            $employee->user->update(['is_active' => false]);
        });
        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => ['message' => 'Employee deactivated.']]);
    }

    public function uploadPhoto(Request $request, int $id): JsonResponse
    {
        $employee = Employee::findOrFail($id);

        $request->validate([
            'photo' => 'required|image|mimes:jpeg,png,webp,gif|max:2048',
        ]);

        $dir = public_path('employees');
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            mkdir($dir, 0755, true);
        }

        if ($employee->photo_path) {
            $old = $dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $employee->photo_path;
            if (file_exists($old)) {
                @unlink($old);
            }
        }

        $ext      = $request->file('photo')->getClientOriginalExtension() ?: 'jpg';
        $filename = 'emp_' . $employee->employee_number . '_' . $employee->id . '_' . time() . '.' . $ext;
        $request->file('photo')->move($dir, $filename);

        $employee->update(['photo_path' => $filename]);

        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => $this->formatEmployee($employee->fresh(['department', 'user']))]);
    }

    public function deletePhoto(int $id): JsonResponse
    {
        $employee = Employee::findOrFail($id);

        if ($employee->photo_path) {
            $path = public_path('employees' . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $employee->photo_path);
            if (file_exists($path)) {
                @unlink($path);
            }
            $employee->update(['photo_path' => null]);
        }

        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => $this->formatEmployee($employee->fresh(['department', 'user']))]);
    }
}

    {
        $data = $this->formatProject($p);

        $data['team'] = $p->relationLoaded('team')
            ? $p->team->map(fn($m) => array_merge($m->toArray(), [
                'employee_name' => $m->relationLoaded('employee') && $m->employee
                    ? trim($m->employee->first_name . ' ' . $m->employee->last_name)
                    : null,
              ]))->toArray()
            : [];

        $data['skills'] = $p->relationLoaded('requiredSkills')
            ? $this->formatSkillsList($p->requiredSkills)
            : [];

        unset($data['required_skills']);
        return $data;
    }

    private function formatSkillsList($requiredSkills): array
    {
        return $requiredSkills->map(fn($s) => [
            'skill_id'       => $s->skill_id,
            'skill_name'     => $s->skill?->name,
            'category_name'  => $s->skill?->category?->name,
            'required_level' => $s->required_level,
            'is_critical'    => $s->is_critical,
        ])->toArray();
    }

            ProjectSkill::where('project_id', $projectId)->with('skill.category')->get()

use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;

class ReviewController extends Controller
{
    private function empName(?Employee $emp): ?string
    {
        return $emp ? trim($emp->first_name . ' ' . $emp->last_name) : null;
    }

    private function formatReview(Review $r): array
    {
        $data = $r->toArray();
        unset($data['employee'], $data['reviewer']);
        if ($r->relationLoaded('employee')) {
            $data['employee_name'] = $this->empName($r->employee);
        }
        if ($r->relationLoaded('reviewer')) {
            $data['reviewer_name'] = $this->empName($r->reviewer);
        }
        if ($r->relationLoaded('skillAssessments')) {
            $data['skill_assessments'] = $r->skillAssessments->map(fn($sa) => array_merge($sa->toArray(), [
                'skill_name' => $sa->relationLoaded('skill') ? $sa->skill?->name : null,
            ]))->toArray();
        }
        if ($r->relationLoaded('trainingPlans')) {
            $data['training_plans'] = $r->trainingPlans->map(fn($tp) => array_merge($tp->toArray(), [
                'skill_name' => $tp->relationLoaded('skill') ? $tp->skill?->name : null,
            ]))->toArray();
        }
        return $data;
    }

    public function index(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $page    = max(1, (int) $request->query('page', 1));
        $perPage = min(100, max(5, (int) $request->query('per_page', 25)));
        $status  = $request->query('status', '');

        $query = Review::with(['employee', 'reviewer']);
        if (in_array($status, ['draft', 'submitted', 'validated'], true)) {
            $query->where('status', $status);
        }

        // RBAC : employee ne voit que ses propres révisions
        $authUser = $request->user();
        if ($authUser->role === 'employee') {
            $empId = $authUser->employee?->id;
            if (!$empId) {
                return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => [], 'meta' => ['total' => 0, 'page' => 1, 'per_page' => $perPage]]);
            }
            $query->where('employee_id', $empId);
        }

        $total = $query->count();
        $rows  = $query->forPage($page, $perPage)->get()->map(fn($r) => $this->formatReview($r));

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'data'   => $rows,
            'meta'   => ['total' => $total, 'page' => $page, 'per_page' => $perPage],
        ]);
    }

    public function show(Request $request, int $id): JsonResponse
    {
        $review = Review::with(['employee', 'reviewer', 'skillAssessments.skill', 'objectives', 'trainingPlans.skill'])->findOrFail($id);

        // RBAC : employee ne peut voir que sa propre révision
        $authUser = $request->user();
        if ($authUser->role === 'employee' && $review->employee_id !== $authUser->employee?->id) {
            return response()->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Accès refusé.'], 403);
        }

        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => $this->formatReview($review)]);
    }

    public function byEmployee(int $employeeId): JsonResponse
    {
        Employee::findOrFail($employeeId);
        $reviews = Review::with(['employee', 'reviewer'])
            ->where('employee_id', $employeeId)
            ->get()
            ->map(fn($r) => $this->formatReview($r));
        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => $reviews]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $request->validate([
            'employee_id' => 'required|integer|exists:employee,id',
            'reviewer_id' => 'required|integer|exists:employee,id',
            'year'        => 'required|integer|min:2000|max:2100',
        ]);

        if (Review::where('employee_id', $request->employee_id)->where('year', $request->year)->exists()) {
            return response()->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'A review already exists for this employee and year.'], 409);
        }

        $review = Review::create($request->only('employee_id', 'reviewer_id', 'year'));
        $review->load(['employee', 'reviewer']);
        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => $this->formatReview($review)], 201);
    }

    public function upsertSkillAssessment(Request $request, int $reviewId): JsonResponse
    {
        $review = Review::findOrFail($reviewId);

        if ($review->status === 'validated') {
            return response()->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Cannot modify a validated review.'], 403);
        }

        $request->validate([
            'skill_id' => 'required|integer|exists:skill,id',
            'rating'   => 'required|integer|between:1,5',
            'comment'  => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        SkillAssessment::updateOrCreate(
            ['review_id' => $reviewId, 'skill_id' => $request->skill_id],
            ['rating' => $request->rating, 'comment' => $request->comment]
        );

        $assessments = SkillAssessment::where('review_id', $reviewId)->with('skill')->get()->map(fn($sa) => array_merge($sa->toArray(), [
            'skill_name' => $sa->skill?->name,
        ]));

        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => $assessments]);
    }

    public function addObjective(Request $request, int $reviewId): JsonResponse
    {
        $review = Review::findOrFail($reviewId);

        if ($review->status === 'validated') {
            return response()->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Cannot modify a validated review.'], 403);
        }

        $request->validate([
            'title'       => 'required|string|min:2|max:200',
            'description' => 'nullable|string',
            'target_date' => 'nullable|date',
        ]);

        $obj = Objective::create(array_merge(['review_id' => $reviewId], $request->only('title', 'description', 'target_date')));
        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => $obj], 201);
    }

    public function updateObjectiveProgress(Request $request, int $objectiveId): JsonResponse
    {
        $obj = Objective::findOrFail($objectiveId);
        $request->validate([
            'completion_rate' => 'required|integer|between:0,100',
            'status'          => 'required|in:pending,in_progress,completed,cancelled',
        ]);

        $obj->update($request->only('completion_rate', 'status'));
        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => $obj]);
    }

    public function addTrainingPlan(Request $request, int $reviewId): JsonResponse
    {
        $review = Review::findOrFail($reviewId);

        if ($review->status === 'validated') {
            return response()->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Cannot modify a validated review.'], 403);
        }

        $request->validate([
            'title'       => 'required|string|min:2|max:200',
            'skill_id'    => 'nullable|integer|exists:skill,id',
            'description' => 'nullable|string',
            'provider'    => 'nullable|string|max:120',
            'start_date'  => 'nullable|date',
            'end_date'    => 'nullable|date|after_or_equal:start_date',
        ]);

        $plan = TrainingPlan::create(array_merge(
            ['review_id' => $reviewId],
            $request->only('title', 'skill_id', 'description', 'provider', 'start_date', 'end_date')
        ));

        $plan->load('skill');
        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => array_merge($plan->toArray(), [
            'skill_name' => $plan->skill?->name,
        ])], 201);
    }

    public function submit(int $id): JsonResponse
    {
        $review = Review::findOrFail($id);

        if ($review->status !== 'draft') {
            return response()->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Only draft reviews can be submitted.'], 422);
        }

        $review->update(['status' => 'submitted']);
        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => $review]);
    }

    public function validate(Request $request, int $id): JsonResponse
    {
        $review = Review::findOrFail($id);

        if ($review->status !== 'submitted') {
            return response()->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Only submitted reviews can be validated.'], 422);
        }

        $request->validate([
            'global_rating' => 'required|numeric|between:1,5',
            'comments'      => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $review->update([
            'global_rating' => $request->global_rating,
            'comments'      => $request->comments,
            'status'        => 'validated',
            'validated_at'  => now(),
        ]);

        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => $review]);
    }
}

        $token = $request->user()->tokens()->findOrFail($id);

    {
        if (!$projectName) {

        }

        $proj = DB::table('project')->where('name', 'like', "%{$projectName}%")->first(['id', 'name']);
        if (!$proj) {
            return "Projet **\"{$projectName}\"** introuvable.\n\n" . $this->listProjectNames();
        }

        // Compétences requises du projet
        $reqCount = DB::table('project_skill')->where('project_id', $proj->id)->count();
        if ($reqCount === 0) {
            return "Le projet **{$proj->name}** n'a pas de compétences requises définies.\nAjoutez-en dans **Projets** → projet → **Compétences requises**.";
        }

        // Meilleurs candidats : pas encore dans l'équipe, évalués sur au moins une compétence requise
        $rows = DB::select('
            SELECT CONCAT(e.first_name," ",e.last_name) AS name,
                   d.name AS dept,
                   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sa.rating >= ps.required_level THEN ps.skill_id END) AS matched,
                   ? AS required,
                   COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT pt2.allocation_pct),0) AS load_pct
            FROM employee e
            JOIN department d ON d.id = e.department_id
            JOIN review r ON r.employee_id = e.id AND r.status = "validated"
            JOIN skill_assessment sa ON sa.review_id = r.id
            JOIN project_skill ps ON ps.skill_id = sa.skill_id AND ps.project_id = ?
            LEFT JOIN project_team pt ON pt.project_id = ? AND pt.employee_id = e.id AND pt.left_at IS NULL
            LEFT JOIN project_team pt2 ON pt2.employee_id = e.id AND pt2.left_at IS NULL
            WHERE e.is_active = 1 AND pt.id IS NULL
            GROUP BY e.id, e.first_name, e.last_name, d.name
            ORDER BY matched DESC, load_pct ASC
            LIMIT 8
        ', [$reqCount, $proj->id, $proj->id]);

        if (empty($rows)) {
            return "Aucun candidat trouvé pour **{$proj->name}**.\n_Assurez-vous que des révisions validées existent._";
        }
        $lines = ["**Candidats pour {$proj->name} (hors équipe actuelle) :**"];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $pct     = $r->required > 0 ? round(($r->matched / $r->required) * 100) : 0;
            $avail   = 100 - min(100, (int) $r->load_pct);
            $score   = round($pct * 0.6 + $avail * 0.4);
            $lines[] = "- **{$r->name}** ({$r->dept}) — {$r->matched}/{$r->required} compétences · charge {$r->load_pct}% · score **{$score}%**";
        }
        $lines[] = "\n_Score = 60% matching compétences + 40% disponibilité._";
        return implode("\n", $lines);
    }

    private function answerReplacementSuggestion(string $memberName, string $projectName): string
    {
        // Résoudre le projet
        $proj = null;
        if ($projectName) {
            $proj = DB::table('project')->where('name', 'like', "%{$projectName}%")->first(['id', 'name']);
            if (!$proj) {
                return "Projet **\"{$projectName}\"** introuvable.\n\n" . $this->listProjectNames();
            }
        }

        // Si pas de nom de membre ni de projet → demander précisions
        if (!$memberName && !$proj) {
            return "Précisez **qui** remplacer et dans **quel projet**.\n\nEx : _\"Qui peut remplacer Jean dans le projet Alpha ?\"_\n\n" . $this->listProjectNames();
        }

        // Résoudre le membre (si projet connu, chercher dans son équipe)
        $member = null;
        if ($memberName) {
            $memberQuery = DB::table('employee as e')
                ->where('e.is_active', 1)
                ->where(fn($q) => $q->where('e.first_name', 'like', "%{$memberName}%")
                                    ->orWhere('e.last_name',  'like', "%{$memberName}%"))
                ->select('e.id', 'e.first_name', 'e.last_name', 'e.job_title');

            if ($proj) {
                $memberQuery->join('project_team as pt', 'pt.employee_id', '=', 'e.id')
                    ->whereNull('pt.left_at')
                    ->where('pt.project_id', $proj->id);
            }
            $member = $memberQuery->first();
        }

        // Si pas de projet mais on a le membre : chercher ses projets actifs
        if (!$proj && $member) {
            $projects = DB::table('project as p')
                ->join('project_team as pt', 'pt.project_id', '=', 'p.id')
                ->whereNull('pt.left_at')
                ->where('pt.employee_id', $member->id)
                ->select('p.id', 'p.name')
                ->get();

            if ($projects->isEmpty()) {
                return "**{$member->first_name} {$member->last_name}** n'est dans aucun projet actif.";
            }
            if ($projects->count() > 1) {
                $lines = ["**{$member->first_name} {$member->last_name}** est dans plusieurs projets. Précisez lequel :"];
                foreach ($projects as $p) $lines[] = "- **{$p->name}**";
                $lines[] = "\nEx : _\"Remplacer {$memberName} dans le projet " . $projects[0]->name . "\"_";
                return implode("\n", $lines);
            }
            $proj = $projects[0];
        }

        if (!$proj) {
            return "Précisez le projet.\nEx : _\"Remplacer {$memberName} dans le projet X\"_\n\n" . $this->listProjectNames();
        }

        if (!$member) {
            $who = $memberName ? "**{$memberName}**" : "ce membre";
            return "Je n'ai pas trouvé {$who} dans l'équipe du projet **{$proj->name}**.";
        }

        // Vérifier que le projet a des compétences requises
        $reqCount = DB::table('project_skill')->where('project_id', $proj->id)->count();
        if ($reqCount === 0) {
            return "Le projet **{$proj->name}** n'a pas de compétences requises définies — impossible de calculer le score.\nAjoutez-en dans **Projets** → {$proj->name} → Compétences requises.";
        }

        // Candidats de remplacement (même logique que AnalysisController)
        $candidates = DB::select('
            SELECT
                CONCAT(e.first_name, " ", e.last_name)                                                AS candidate_name,
                d.name                                                                                 AS department_name,
                COUNT(ps.skill_id)                                                                     AS required_count,
                SUM(CASE WHEN vsm.current_level IS NOT NULL
                          AND vsm.current_level >= ps.required_level THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)               AS matched_count,
                ROUND(
                    SUM(CASE WHEN vsm.current_level IS NOT NULL
                              AND vsm.current_level >= ps.required_level THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                    / COUNT(ps.skill_id) * 100
                , 0)                                                                                   AS match_score_pct,
                COALESCE(alloc.total_allocation_pct, 0)                                                AS allocation_pct
            FROM employee e
            JOIN department d ON d.id = e.department_id
            JOIN project_skill ps ON ps.project_id = ?
            LEFT JOIN view_skills_matrix vsm ON vsm.skill_id = ps.skill_id AND vsm.employee_id = e.id
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT employee_id, SUM(allocation_pct) AS total_allocation_pct
                FROM project_team WHERE left_at IS NULL GROUP BY employee_id
            ) alloc ON alloc.employee_id = e.id
            WHERE e.is_active = 1
              AND e.id != ?
              AND e.id NOT IN (SELECT employee_id FROM project_team WHERE project_id = ? AND left_at IS NULL)
            GROUP BY e.id, e.first_name, e.last_name, d.name, alloc.total_allocation_pct
            HAVING match_score_pct > 0
            ORDER BY match_score_pct DESC, allocation_pct ASC
            LIMIT 5
        ', [$proj->id, $member->id, $proj->id]);

        $memberFullName = "{$member->first_name} {$member->last_name}";

        if (empty($candidates)) {
            return "Aucun candidat trouvé pour remplacer **{$memberFullName}** dans **{$proj->name}**.\n_Assurez-vous que des révisions validées existent pour alimenter la matrice._";
        }

        $lines  = ["**Candidats pour remplacer {$memberFullName} dans {$proj->name} :**"];
        $medals = ['🥇', '🥈', '🥉', '4.', '5.'];
        foreach ($candidates as $i => $c) {
            $overloaded = $c->allocation_pct >= 100 ? ' ⚠️ surchargé' : " · charge {$c->allocation_pct}%";
            $lines[]    = "{$medals[$i]} **{$c->candidate_name}** ({$c->department_name}) — {$c->matched_count}/{$c->required_count} compétences · **{$c->match_score_pct}%**{$overloaded}";
        }
        $lines[] = "\n_Pour la simulation complète : **Projets** → {$proj->name} → Remplacer → Comparer._";
        return implode("\n", $lines);
    }

    /**
     * Détecte si la question nécessite un accès aux données réelles (DB).
     * Résultat : true → modèle lourd + tools, false → modèle léger sans tools.
     */
    private function needsDataAccess(string $question): bool
    {
        if (!$question) return false;

        $q     = $this->normalize($question);
        $words = preg_split('/[\s\W]+/', $q, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
        $has   = fn(string $kw) => $this->keywordFound($kw, $q, $words);

        // Questions explicitement explicatives → pas besoin de données
        if ($has('expliquer') || $has('explication') || $has('definir') || $has('definition')
            || $has('pourquoi') || $has('signifie') || $has('fonctionne') || $has('difference')
            || $has('avantage') || $has('inconvenient') || $has('principe') || $has('theorie')) {
            return false;
        }

        // Signaux de requête de données HRMS
        $dataSignals = [
            'employe', 'employee', 'projet', 'project', 'revision', 'review',
            'competence', 'skill', 'departement', 'department', 'equipe', 'team',
            'charge', 'workload', 'disponible', 'available', 'candidat', 'candidate',
            'remplacer', 'remplacement', 'replace', 'replacement', 'successeur',
            'performance', 'note', 'score', 'rating', 'evaluation',
            'gap', 'manque', 'lacune', 'statistique', 'rapport', 'analyse',
            'combien', 'liste', 'quels', 'resume', 'recapitulatif',
        ];

        $count = 0;
        foreach ($dataSignals as $kw) {
            if ($has($kw) && ++$count >= 2) return true;
        }

        // Nom propre (majuscule non en début de phrase) + au moins 1 signal → requête personnelle
        if ($count >= 1 && preg_match('/(?<!\A|\.\s)\b[A-ZÁÉÈÊÀÙÎÔ][a-záéèêàùîô]{2,}\b/', $question)) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function isComplexQuestion(string $question): bool
    {
        $q = $this->normalize($question);

        // Verbes d'explication ou d'analyse → modèle lourd
        $complexVerbs = ['expliqu', 'decris', 'decrivez', 'definit', 'definis', 'presente',
                         'presentez', 'resume', 'compare', 'analys', 'developp', 'detail',
                         'elabor', 'describe', 'explain', 'discuss', 'elaborate', 'what is', 'quest ce'];
        foreach ($complexVerbs as $v) {
            if (str_contains($q, $v)) return true;
        }

        // Question longue (> 10 mots)
        if (str_word_count($question) > 10) return true;

        // Plusieurs propositions (virgule/point-virgule)
        if (preg_match('/[,;].*[,;]/', $question)) return true;

        return false;
    }

    private function getRelevantLearned(string $question): string
    {
        $q      = $this->normalize($question);
        $qWords = array_filter(
            preg_split('/[\s\W]+/', $q, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY),
            fn($w) => strlen($w) >= 4
        );
        if (empty($qWords)) return '';

        try {
            $items = DB::table('chat_learned')
                ->orderByDesc('usage_count')
                ->limit(60)
                ->get(['id', 'keywords', 'condensed']);
        } catch (\Throwable) {
            return '';
        }

        $matched = [];
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $keywords = json_decode($item->keywords, true) ?? [];
            $score    = 0;
            foreach ($qWords as $qw) {
                foreach ($keywords as $kw) {
                    if (str_contains($kw, $qw) || str_contains($qw, $kw)) { $score++; break; }
                }
            }
            if ($score > 0) $matched[] = ['score' => $score, 'condensed' => $item->condensed, 'id' => $item->id];
        }
        if (empty($matched)) return '';

        usort($matched, fn($a, $b) => $b['score'] - $a['score']);
        $top = array_slice($matched, 0, 3);

        try {
            DB::table('chat_learned')->whereIn('id', array_column($top, 'id'))->increment('usage_count');
        } catch (\Throwable) {}

        return implode("\n", array_map(fn($m) => '- ' . $m['condensed'], $top));
    }

    private function streamOllama(array $messages, bool $heavy = false, bool $clarify = false): \Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse
    {
        $ollamaUrl  = rtrim(config('services.ollama.url', 'http://localhost:11434'), '/');
        $lightModel = config('services.ollama.model', 'qwen2.5:0.5b');
        $heavyModel = config('services.ollama.model_heavy', $lightModel);
        $toolModel  = config('services.ollama.model_tools', $heavyModel);

        // Extraire la dernière question utilisateur pour détecter le besoin de données
        $lastUserMsg = '';
        foreach (array_reverse($messages) as $m) {
            if (($m['role'] ?? '') === 'user') { $lastUserMsg = $m['content'] ?? ''; break; }
        }
        $needsData = $this->needsDataAccess($lastUserMsg);

        // Si la question touche aux données réelles → modèle lourd + tools
        // Sinon → modèle léger, pas de tools (conversation générale)
        $useTools    = !$clarify && config('services.ollama.tools_enabled', true) && $needsData;
        $ollamaModel = ($heavy || $needsData) ? $heavyModel : $lightModel;
        $source      = $clarify ? 'llm-clarify' : (($heavy || $needsData) ? 'llm-heavy' : 'llm');

        return response()->stream(function () use ($messages, $ollamaModel, $toolModel, $ollamaUrl, $source, $useTools) {
            @ini_set('output_buffering', '0');
            echo "data: " . json_encode(['type' => 'meta', 'source' => $source]) . "\n\n";
            ob_flush(); flush();

            // Fonction locale : stream SSE depuis Ollama
            $doStream = function (array $msgs, string $model) use ($ollamaUrl): void {
                $response = Http::withOptions(['stream' => true])
                    ->timeout(120)
                    ->post("{$ollamaUrl}/api/chat", [
                        'model'    => $model,
                        'stream'   => true,
                        'messages' => $msgs,
                    ]);
                if (!$response->successful()) {
                    echo "data: " . json_encode(['type' => 'error']) . "\n\n";
                    ob_flush(); flush();
                    return;
                }
                $body   = $response->getBody();
                $buffer = '';
                while (!$body->eof()) {
                    $chunk  = $body->read(4096);
                    $buffer .= $chunk;
                    while (($pos = strpos($buffer, "\n")) !== false) {
                        $line   = trim(substr($buffer, 0, $pos));
                        $buffer = substr($buffer, $pos + 1);
                        if ($line === '') continue;
                        $data = json_decode($line, true);
                        if (json_last_error() !== JSON_ERROR_NONE) continue;
                        if (!empty($data['message']['content'])) {
                            echo "data: " . json_encode(['type' => 'token', 'token' => $data['message']['content']]) . "\n\n";
                            ob_flush(); flush();
                        }
                        if ($data['done'] ?? false) break 2;
                    }
                }
            };

            try {
                if ($useTools) {
                    // Étape 1 : appel non-streaming avec tools pour détecter les appels de fonction
                    $resp1 = Http::timeout(45)->post("{$ollamaUrl}/api/chat", [
                        'model'    => $toolModel,
                        'stream'   => false,
                        'messages' => $messages,
                        'tools'    => self::OLLAMA_TOOLS,
                    ]);

                    if ($resp1->successful()) {
                        $data1     = $resp1->json();
                        $toolCalls = $data1['message']['tool_calls'] ?? [];

                        if (!empty($toolCalls)) {
                            // Étape 2 : exécuter les tools (lecture DB) et ajouter les résultats
                            $messages[] = [
                                'role'       => 'assistant',
                                'content'    => $data1['message']['content'] ?? '',
                                'tool_calls' => $toolCalls,
                            ];
                            foreach ($toolCalls as $tc) {
                                $fnName     = $tc['function']['name'] ?? '';
                                $fnArgs     = $tc['function']['arguments'] ?? [];
                                if (is_string($fnArgs)) $fnArgs = json_decode($fnArgs, true) ?? [];
                                $result     = $this->executeOllamaTool($fnName, $fnArgs);
                                $messages[] = [
                                    'role'    => 'tool',
                                    'content' => json_encode($result, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
                                ];
                            }
                            // Étape 3 : réponse finale en streaming avec les données injectées
                            $doStream($messages, $toolModel);
                            echo "data: [DONE]\n\n";
                            ob_flush(); flush();
                            return;
                        }

                        // Pas de tool calls : le modèle a répondu directement → émettre en tokens
                        $content = $data1['message']['content'] ?? '';
                        if ($content) {
                            foreach (str_split($content, 25) as $chunk) {
                                echo "data: " . json_encode(['type' => 'token', 'token' => $chunk]) . "\n\n";
                                ob_flush(); flush();
                            }
                            echo "data: [DONE]\n\n";
                            ob_flush(); flush();
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                    // Fallback si l'appel tools a échoué → streaming direct sans tools
                }

                $doStream($messages, $ollamaModel);
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                echo "data: " . json_encode(['type' => 'error']) . "\n\n";
                ob_flush(); flush();
            }

            echo "data: [DONE]\n\n";
            ob_flush(); flush();
        }, 200, $this->sseHeaders());
    }

    private function toolCountEmployees(): array
    {
        $active   = DB::table('employee')->where('is_active', 1)->count();
        $inactive = DB::table('employee')->where('is_active', 0)->count();
        $depts    = DB::table('department')->count();
        return [
            'actifs'       => $active,
            'inactifs'     => $inactive,
            'total'        => $active + $inactive,
            'departements' => $depts,
        ];
    }

    private function toolGetDepartments(): array
    {
        $rows = DB::select('
            SELECT d.name, COUNT(CASE WHEN e.is_active=1 THEN 1 END) AS employes_actifs
            FROM department d
            LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.department_id = d.id
            GROUP BY d.id, d.name
            ORDER BY employes_actifs DESC
        ');
        return ['departements' => array_map(fn($r) => [
            'nom'             => $r->name,
            'employes_actifs' => (int) $r->employes_actifs,
        ], $rows)];
    }

    private function toolGetProjects(string $status = 'all'): array
    {
        $query = DB::table('project as p')
            ->select('p.name', 'p.status', DB::raw('COUNT(DISTINCT pt.employee_id) AS team_size'))
            ->leftJoin('project_team as pt', fn($j) => $j->on('pt.project_id', '=', 'p.id')->whereNull('pt.left_at'))
            ->groupBy('p.id', 'p.name', 'p.status')
            ->orderBy('p.name');
        if ($status !== 'all') $query->where('p.status', $status);
        return ['projets' => $query->get()->map(fn($r) => [
            'nom'          => $r->name,
            'statut'       => $r->status,
            'taille_equipe'=> (int) $r->team_size,
        ])->toArray()];
    }

    private function toolSearchEmployee(string $name): array
    {
        if (!$name) return ['erreur' => 'Nom manquant'];
        $rows = DB::table('employee as e')
            ->join('department as d', 'd.id', '=', 'e.department_id')
            ->select(
                DB::raw("CONCAT(e.first_name,' ',e.last_name) AS nom"),
                'e.job_title AS poste',
                'd.name AS departement',
                DB::raw("IF(e.is_active,'actif','inactif') AS statut")
            )
            ->where(fn($q) => $q->where('e.first_name', 'like', "%$name%")->orWhere('e.last_name', 'like', "%$name%"))
            ->limit(5)->get();
        return ['employes' => $rows->toArray(), 'total' => $rows->count()];
    }

    private function toolGetEmployeesWithSkill(string $skill): array
    {
        if (!$skill) return ['erreur' => 'Compétence manquante'];
        $rows = DB::select('
            SELECT CONCAT(e.first_name," ",e.last_name) AS nom,
                   d.name AS departement, sk.name AS competence,
                   MAX(sa.rating) AS niveau
            FROM skill_assessment sa
            JOIN skill sk   ON sk.id = sa.skill_id
            JOIN review r   ON r.id  = sa.review_id AND r.status = "validated"
            JOIN employee e ON e.id  = r.employee_id AND e.is_active = 1
            JOIN department d ON d.id = e.department_id
            WHERE sk.name LIKE ?
            GROUP BY e.id, e.first_name, e.last_name, d.name, sk.name
            ORDER BY niveau DESC
            LIMIT 10
        ', ["%{$skill}%"]);
        return [
            'competence' => !empty($rows) ? $rows[0]->competence : $skill,
            'employes'   => array_map(fn($r) => [
                'nom'        => $r->nom,
                'departement'=> $r->departement,
                'niveau'     => (int) $r->niveau,
                'sur_5'      => 5,
            ], $rows),
            'total' => count($rows),
        ];
    }

    private function toolGetAvailableEmployees(): array
    {

            SELECT CONCAT(e.first_name," ",e.last_name) AS nom,
                   d.name AS departement,
                   COALESCE(SUM(pt.allocation_pct),0) AS charge_pct
            FROM employee e
            JOIN department d ON d.id = e.department_id
            LEFT JOIN project_team pt ON pt.employee_id = e.id AND pt.left_at IS NULL
            WHERE e.is_active = 1
            GROUP BY e.id, e.first_name, e.last_name, d.name
            HAVING charge_pct < 80
            ORDER BY charge_pct ASC

        return [
            'employes_disponibles' => array_map(fn($r) => [
                'nom'        => $r->nom,
                'departement'=> $r->departement,
                'charge_pct' => (int) $r->charge_pct,

    private function toolGetProjectCandidates(string $projectName): array
    {
        if (!$projectName) return ['erreur' => 'Nom de projet manquant'];
        $proj = DB::table('project')->where('name', 'like', "%{$projectName}%")->first(['id', 'name']);
        if (!$proj) return ['erreur' => "Projet '{$projectName}' introuvable"];
        $reqCount = DB::table('project_skill')->where('project_id', $proj->id)->count();
        if ($reqCount === 0) return ['erreur' => 'Aucune compétence requise définie', 'projet' => $proj->name];
        $rows = DB::select('
            SELECT CONCAT(e.first_name," ",e.last_name) AS nom,
                   d.name AS departement,
                   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sa.rating >= ps.required_level THEN ps.skill_id END) AS correspondances,
                   ? AS requis,
                   COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT pt2.allocation_pct),0) AS charge_pct
            FROM employee e
            JOIN department d ON d.id = e.department_id
            JOIN review r ON r.employee_id = e.id AND r.status = "validated"
            JOIN skill_assessment sa ON sa.review_id = r.id
            JOIN project_skill ps ON ps.skill_id = sa.skill_id AND ps.project_id = ?
            LEFT JOIN project_team pt ON pt.project_id = ? AND pt.employee_id = e.id AND pt.left_at IS NULL
            LEFT JOIN project_team pt2 ON pt2.employee_id = e.id AND pt2.left_at IS NULL
            WHERE e.is_active = 1 AND pt.id IS NULL
            GROUP BY e.id, e.first_name, e.last_name, d.name
            ORDER BY correspondances DESC, charge_pct ASC
            LIMIT 8
        ', [$reqCount, $proj->id, $proj->id]);
        return [
            'projet'    => $proj->name,
            'candidats' => array_map(fn($r) => [
                'nom'            => $r->nom,
                'departement'    => $r->departement,
                'correspondances'=> (int) $r->correspondances,
                'requis'         => (int) $r->requis,
                'charge_pct'     => (int) $r->charge_pct,
                'score_pct'      => (int) round(
                    ($r->requis > 0 ? ($r->correspondances / $r->requis) * 60 : 0)
                    + max(0, 100 - (int) $r->charge_pct) * 0.4
                ),
            ], $rows),
            'total' => count($rows),
        ];
    }

    private function toolGetReplacementCandidates(string $memberName, string $projectName): array
    {
        if (!$memberName || !$projectName) return ['erreur' => 'member_name et project_name sont requis'];
        $proj = DB::table('project')->where('name', 'like', "%{$projectName}%")->first(['id', 'name']);
        if (!$proj) return ['erreur' => "Projet '{$projectName}' introuvable"];
        $member = DB::table('employee as e')
            ->join('project_team as pt', 'pt.employee_id', '=', 'e.id')
            ->whereNull('pt.left_at')
            ->where('pt.project_id', $proj->id)
            ->where('e.is_active', 1)
            ->where(fn($q) => $q->where('e.first_name', 'like', "%{$memberName}%")
                                ->orWhere('e.last_name', 'like', "%{$memberName}%"))
            ->select('e.id', 'e.first_name', 'e.last_name')
            ->first();
        if (!$member) return ['erreur' => "Membre '{$memberName}' introuvable dans l'équipe de {$proj->name}"];
        $candidates = DB::select('
            SELECT CONCAT(e.first_name," ",e.last_name) AS nom,
                   d.name AS departement,
                   COUNT(ps.skill_id) AS requis,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN vsm.current_level IS NOT NULL AND vsm.current_level >= ps.required_level THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correspondances,
                   ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN vsm.current_level IS NOT NULL AND vsm.current_level >= ps.required_level THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(ps.skill_id) * 100, 0) AS score_pct,
                   COALESCE(alloc.total_allocation_pct, 0) AS charge_pct
            FROM employee e
            JOIN department d ON d.id = e.department_id
            JOIN project_skill ps ON ps.project_id = ?
            LEFT JOIN view_skills_matrix vsm ON vsm.skill_id = ps.skill_id AND vsm.employee_id = e.id
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT employee_id, SUM(allocation_pct) AS total_allocation_pct
                       FROM project_team WHERE left_at IS NULL GROUP BY employee_id) alloc ON alloc.employee_id = e.id
            WHERE e.is_active = 1 AND e.id != ?
              AND e.id NOT IN (SELECT employee_id FROM project_team WHERE project_id = ? AND left_at IS NULL)
            GROUP BY e.id, e.first_name, e.last_name, d.name, alloc.total_allocation_pct
            HAVING score_pct > 0
            ORDER BY score_pct DESC, charge_pct ASC
            LIMIT 5
        ', [$proj->id, $member->id, $proj->id]);
        return [
            'membre_remplace' => "{$member->first_name} {$member->last_name}",
            'projet'          => $proj->name,
            'candidats'       => array_map(fn($c) => [
                'nom'            => $c->nom,
                'departement'    => $c->departement,
                'correspondances'=> (int) $c->correspondances,
                'requis'         => (int) $c->requis,
                'score_pct'      => (int) $c->score_pct,
                'charge_pct'     => (int) $c->charge_pct,
            ], $candidates),
        ];
    }

    private function toolGetSkillGap(string $projectName): array
    {
        if (!$projectName) return ['erreur' => 'Nom de projet manquant'];
        $proj = DB::table('project')->where('name', 'like', "%{$projectName}%")->first(['id', 'name']);
        if (!$proj) return ['erreur' => "Projet '{$projectName}' introuvable"];
        $rows = DB::select('
            SELECT sk.name AS competence, ps.required_level AS niveau_requis, ps.is_critical AS critique,
                   MAX(CASE WHEN sa.rating >= ps.required_level THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS couverte
            FROM project_skill ps
            JOIN skill sk ON sk.id = ps.skill_id
            LEFT JOIN project_team pt ON pt.project_id = ps.project_id AND pt.left_at IS NULL
            LEFT JOIN review r ON r.employee_id = pt.employee_id AND r.status = "validated"
            LEFT JOIN skill_assessment sa ON sa.review_id = r.id AND sa.skill_id = ps.skill_id
            WHERE ps.project_id = ?
            GROUP BY sk.id, sk.name, ps.required_level, ps.is_critical
            HAVING couverte = 0 OR couverte IS NULL
        ', [$proj->id]);
        return [
            'projet'                 => $proj->name,
            'competences_manquantes' => array_map(fn($r) => [
                'competence'    => $r->competence,
                'niveau_requis' => (int) $r->niveau_requis,
                'critique'      => (bool) $r->critique,
            ], $rows),
            'total_manquant'   => count($rows),
            'toutes_couvertes' => count($rows) === 0,
        ];
    }

    // TIER 0 — Action intents : navigation + pré-remplissage
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    private function resolveActionIntent(string $question, string $role): ?array
    {
        $q      = $this->normalize($question);
        $qWords = preg_split('/[\s\W]+/', $q, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
        $has    = fn(string $kw) => $this->keywordFound($kw, $q, $qWords);

        // "comment…" / "voir…" / "liste…" → navigation ou consultation → laisser passer au FAQ/Tier2
        if ($has('comment') || str_contains($q, 'etape') || str_contains($q, 'comment faire')) {
            return null;
        }

        // Intent de consultation (vue, liste, affichage) sans verbe d'action → Tier 2
        $wantsView = $has('voir') || $has('liste') || $has('lister') || $has('afficher')
                  || $has('show') || $has('montrer') || $has('consulter') || $has('noms') || $has('tous');
        if ($wantsView
            && !$has('ajouter') && !$has('creer') && !$has('add')
            && !$has('create')  && !$has('nouveau') && !$has('nouvelle') && !$has('new')) {
            return null;
        }

        $wantsAction = $has('ajouter') || $has('creer') || $has('nouveau') || $has('nouvelle')
                    || $has('add') || $has('create') || $has('new');

        // ── Ajouter un employé ────────────────────────────────────
        if ($wantsAction && ($has('employe') || $has('employee'))) {
            if ($role !== 'hr') {
                return ['reply' => "❌ Vous n'avez pas les droits pour créer un employé.\nSeul le rôle **HR** peut effectuer cette action.", 'action' => null];
            }
            $prefill = $this->extractEmployeePrefill($question);
            $lines   = ["Je vous redirige vers le formulaire d'ajout d'employé."];
            if (!empty($prefill)) {
                $lines[] = "\n📋 **Informations extraites :**";
                $labels  = [
                    'first_name'      => 'Prénom',
                    'last_name'       => 'Nom',
                    'job_title'       => 'Poste',
                    'email'           => 'Email',
                    'department_name' => 'Département',
                    'phone'           => 'Téléphone',
                ];
                foreach ($prefill as $k => $v) {
                    if (isset($labels[$k])) $lines[] = "- {$labels[$k]} : **{$v}**";
                }
                $lines[] = "\n_Vérifiez et complétez les champs manquants avant de sauvegarder._";
            }
            return ['reply' => implode("\n", $lines), 'action' => ['type' => 'navigate', 'route' => '/employees/new', 'prefill' => $prefill]];
        }

        // ── Créer un projet ──────────────────────────────────────
        if ($wantsAction && ($has('projet') || $has('project'))) {
            if ($role !== 'hr' && $role !== 'manager') {
                return ['reply' => "❌ Vous n'avez pas les droits pour créer un projet.\nSeuls les rôles **HR** et **Manager** peuvent effectuer cette action.", 'action' => null];
            }
            $prefill = $this->extractProjectPrefill($question);
            $lines   = ["Je vous redirige vers le formulaire de création de projet."];
            if (!empty($prefill)) {
                $lines[] = "\n📋 **Informations extraites :**";
                if (!empty($prefill['name'])) $lines[] = "- Nom : **{$prefill['name']}**";
                if (!empty($prefill['code'])) $lines[] = "- Code : **{$prefill['code']}**";
                $lines[] = "\n_Vérifiez et complétez les champs manquants avant de sauvegarder._";
            }
            return ['reply' => implode("\n", $lines), 'action' => ['type' => 'navigate', 'route' => '/projects/new', 'prefill' => $prefill]];
        }

        // ── Créer une révision ───────────────────────────────────
        if ($wantsAction && ($has('revision') || $has('review') || $has('evaluation'))) {
            if ($role !== 'hr' && $role !== 'manager') {
                return ['reply' => "❌ Vous n'avez pas les droits pour créer une révision.\nSeuls les rôles **HR** et **Manager** peuvent effectuer cette action.", 'action' => null];
            }
            $prefill = $this->extractReviewPrefill($question);
            $lines   = ["Je vous redirige vers le formulaire de création de révision."];
            if (!empty($prefill['employee_name'] ?? '')) {
                $lines[] = "\n📋 Employé détecté : **{$prefill['employee_name']}**";
                unset($prefill['employee_name']);
            }
            return ['reply' => implode("\n", $lines), 'action' => ['type' => 'navigate', 'route' => '/reviews/new', 'prefill' => $prefill]];
        }

        return null;
    }

    // ── Extraction structurée par LLM (enrichit le prefill regex) ──

    private function llmExtractFields(string $message, string $entityType): array
    {
        $schemas = [
            'employee' => '{"first_name":"","last_name":"","job_title":"","email":"","department_name":"","phone":""}',
            'project'  => '{"name":"","code":"","description":"","status":""}',
            'review'   => '{"year":""}',
        ];

        $schema = $schemas[$entityType] ?? null;
        if (!$schema) return [];

        $ollamaUrl = rtrim(config('services.ollama.url', 'http://localhost:11434'), '/');
        $model     = config('services.ollama.model', 'qwen2.5:0.5b');

        try {
            $response = Http::timeout(5)->post("{$ollamaUrl}/api/generate", [
                'model'  => $model,
                'stream' => false,
                'format' => 'json',
                'prompt' => "Extract HR form fields from this request. Fill only the keys explicitly mentioned. Return a valid JSON object matching this schema exactly: {$schema}\n\nRequest: \"{$message}\"\n\nRules: Return ONLY the JSON. Leave keys empty string if not mentioned. Do not invent values.",
            ]);

            if (!$response->successful()) return [];

            $text   = trim($response->json('response', ''));
            $fields = json_decode($text, true);

            if (!is_array($fields)) {
                if (preg_match('/\{.*\}/s', $text, $m)) {
                    $fields = json_decode($m[0], true);
                }
            }

            if (!is_array($fields)) return [];

            // Garder uniquement les valeurs non vides
            return array_filter($fields, fn($v) => is_string($v) && $v !== '');
        } catch (\Throwable) {
            return [];
        }
    }

    private function extractEmployeePrefill(string $question): array
    {
        $prefill = [];

        // Email
        if (preg_match('/\b[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}\b/i', $question, $m)) {
            $prefill['email'] = $m[0];
        }

        // Prénom + Nom après "employé"
        if (preg_match('/employ[eé]s?\s+([A-ZÀ-Ùa-zà-ù][a-zà-ù\-]+)\s+([A-ZÀ-Ùa-zà-ù][a-zà-ù\-]+)/iu', $question, $m)) {
            $prefill['first_name'] = $m[1];
            $prefill['last_name']  = $m[2];
        }

        // Poste : après "poste", "titre", "comme", "en tant que"
        if (preg_match('/(?:poste|titre|job|comme|en tant que)\s*[:\s]\s*([A-ZÀ-Ùa-zà-ù][\w\s\-]{2,50}?)(?:\s+(?:dans|au|email|dep|,|$))/iu', $question, $m)) {
            $prefill['job_title'] = trim($m[1]);
        } elseif (!empty($prefill['first_name']) &&
            preg_match('/'.preg_quote($prefill['last_name'] ?? '', '/').'[\s,]+([A-ZÀ-Ùa-zà-ù][\w\s\-]{2,50}?)(?:\s+(?:dans|au|email|dep|,)|$)/iu', $question, $m)) {
            $prefill['job_title'] = trim($m[1]);
        }

        // LLM enrichit le prefill regex (LLM prend le dessus sauf pour les noms déjà trouvés)
        $llm = $this->llmExtractFields($question, 'employee');
        foreach ($llm as $k => $v) {
            if (!isset($prefill[$k])) $prefill[$k] = $v; // LLM ajoute les champs manquants
        }
        // Pour job_title : LLM est souvent plus précis
        if (!empty($llm['job_title'])) $prefill['job_title'] = $llm['job_title'];

        return array_filter($prefill);
    }

    private function extractProjectPrefill(string $question): array
    {
        $prefill = [];

        if (preg_match('/projet\s+(?:nomm[eé]|appel[eé]|:)?\s*["\']?([A-ZÀ-Ùa-zà-ù0-9][\w\s\-]{1,60}?)["\']?(?:\s+(?:code|statut|debut|fin|desc|,)|$)/iu', $question, $m)) {
            $name = trim($m[1]);
            $prefill['name'] = $name;
            $prefill['code'] = strtoupper(substr(preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9]/', '', $name), 0, 8));
        }

        if (preg_match('/(?:description|desc)\s*[:\s]\s*(.{5,200}?)(?:\s*(?:code|statut|debut)|$)/iu', $question, $m)) {
            $prefill['description'] = trim($m[1]);
        }

        // LLM enrichit les champs manquants
        $llm = $this->llmExtractFields($question, 'project');
        foreach (['name', 'description', 'status'] as $k) {
            if (!isset($prefill[$k]) && !empty($llm[$k])) $prefill[$k] = $llm[$k];
        }
        // Recalcul du code si LLM a trouvé un nom que regex a raté
        if (empty($prefill['code']) && !empty($prefill['name'])) {
            $prefill['code'] = strtoupper(substr(preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9]/', '', $prefill['name']), 0, 8));
        }

        return array_filter($prefill);
    }

    private function extractReviewPrefill(string $question): array
    {
        $prefill = [];

        if (preg_match('/\b(20\d{2})\b/', $question, $m)) {
            $prefill['year'] = $m[1];
        }

        // Cherche l'employé par nom → récupère son ID
        if (preg_match('/(?:pour|de l\'?employ[eé]|l\'?employ[eé])\s+([A-ZÀ-Ùa-zà-ù][a-zà-ù\-]+(?:\s+[A-ZÀ-Ùa-zà-ù][a-zà-ù\-]+)?)/iu', $question, $m)) {
            $name   = trim($m[1]);
            $parts  = preg_split('/\s+/', $name);
            $first  = $parts[0];
            $last   = $parts[1] ?? null;
            $row = DB::table('employee')
                ->where('is_active', 1)
                ->where(function($q) use ($first, $last) {
                    $q->where('first_name', 'like', "%{$first}%")
                      ->orWhere('last_name',  'like', "%{$first}%");
                    if ($last) {
                        $q->orWhere('first_name', 'like', "%{$last}%")
                          ->orWhere('last_name',  'like', "%{$last}%");
                    }
                })
                ->first(['id', 'first_name', 'last_name']);
            if ($row) {
                $prefill['employee_id']   = $row->id;
                $prefill['employee_name'] = "{$row->first_name} {$row->last_name}";
            }
        }

        return array_filter($prefill);
    }

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Helpers FAQ matching
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    private function normalize(string $text): string
    {
        $text = mb_strtolower($text, 'UTF-8');
        return str_replace(
            ['é','è','ê','ë','à','â','ä','ô','ö','ù','û','ü','î','ï','ç'],
            ['e','e','e','e','a','a','a','o','o','u','u','u','i','i','c'],
            $text
        );
    }

    private function keywordFound(string $kw, string $fullQ, array $qWords): bool
    {
        if (str_contains($fullQ, $kw)) return true;
        $maxDist = max(1, (int) floor(strlen($kw) * 0.35));
        foreach ($qWords as $qw) {
            if (strlen($qw) < 3) continue;
            // Le mot de l'utilisateur commence par le keyword (ex: "desactiver" → keyword "desactiv")
            if (str_starts_with($qw, $kw)) return true;
            if (abs(strlen($qw) - strlen($kw)) <= $maxDist && levenshtein($qw, $kw) <= $maxDist) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function checkFaq(string $question): ?string
    {
        $q      = $this->normalize($question);
        $qWords = preg_split('/[\s\W]+/', $q, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
        foreach (self::FAQ as $faq) {
            foreach ($faq['keys'] as $entry) {
                $keywords = is_array($entry) ? $entry : [$entry];
                $allFound = true;
                foreach ($keywords as $kw) {
                    if (!$this->keywordFound($kw, $q, $qWords)) { $allFound = false; break; }
                }
                if ($allFound) return $faq['answer'];
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    public function suggestions(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $q = $this->normalize($request->input('q', ''));

        // Questions populaires (taux de "good" feedback élevé)
        try {
            $popular = DB::table('chat_feedback')
                ->select('question', DB::raw('COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(rating="good") AS goods'))
                ->groupBy('question')
                ->havingRaw('goods / total >= 0.6')
                ->orderByDesc('goods')
                ->limit(8)
                ->pluck('question')
                ->toArray();
        } catch (\Throwable) {
            $popular = [];
        }

        $all = array_values(array_unique(array_merge(self::SUGGESTIONS, $popular)));

        if ($q) {
            $all = array_values(array_filter(
                $all,
                fn($s) => str_contains($this->normalize($s), $q)
            ));
        }

        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => array_slice($all, 0, 20)]);
    }

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Point d'entrée
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    public function chat(Request $request): \Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse
    {
        $request->validate([
            'message'           => 'required|string|max:2000',
            'history'           => 'array|max:20',
            'history.*.role'    => 'required|in:user,assistant',
            'history.*.content' => 'required|string|max:2000',
        ]);

        $message       = $request->input('message');
        $userRole      = $request->user()->role;
        $forceLlm      = $request->boolean('force_llm', false);
        $modelOverride = $request->input('model_override');
        $clarify       = $request->boolean('clarify', false);

        // Tiers 0-2 ignorés si on force l'envoi vers Ollama
        if (!$forceLlm && !$clarify) {

            // Tier 0 — Action intents
            if (($intent = $this->resolveActionIntent($message, $userRole)) !== null) {
                return $this->sseComplete($intent['reply'], 'action', $intent['action'] ?? null);
            }

            // Pré-Tier 1 — "mon rôle / mes droits"
            $nMsg   = $this->normalize($message);
            $nWords = preg_split('/[\s\W]+/', $nMsg, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
            $hMsg   = fn(string $kw) => $this->keywordFound($kw, $nMsg, $nWords);
            if (($hMsg('mon') || $hMsg('mes') || $hMsg('my') || $hMsg('moi'))
                && ($hMsg('role') || $hMsg('droit') || $hMsg('permission') || $hMsg('acces') || $hMsg('access'))) {
                return $this->sseComplete($this->answerMyRole($request->user()->role), 'faq');
            }

            // Tier 1 — FAQ navigation
            if ($answer = $this->checkFaq($message)) {
                return $this->sseComplete($answer, 'faq');
            }

            // Tier 2 — Data intents (DB direct)
            if ($answer = $this->resolveDataIntent($message)) {
                return $this->sseComplete($answer, 'faq');
            }

            // Tier 2b — Context follow-up : si le dernier message bot demandait un nom de projet,
            //           la réponse courte (≤6 mots) est traitée comme nom de projet
            $histData = $request->input('history', []);
            $lastBotContent = '';
            foreach (array_reverse($histData) as $h) {
                if ($h['role'] === 'assistant') { $lastBotContent = $this->normalize($h['content']); break; }
            }
            if ($lastBotContent && str_word_count($message) <= 6) {
                $wasCandidateAsk = str_contains($lastBotContent, 'candidat') && str_contains($lastBotContent, 'projet');
                $wasSkillGapAsk  = (str_contains($lastBotContent, 'manqu') || str_contains($lastBotContent, 'gap'))
                                 && str_contains($lastBotContent, 'projet');
                $wasGenericAsk   = str_contains($lastBotContent, 'nom du projet') || str_contains($lastBotContent, 'precisez');

                if ($wasCandidateAsk || ($wasGenericAsk && !$wasSkillGapAsk)) {
                    return $this->sseComplete($this->answerProjectCandidates(trim($message)), 'faq');
                }
                if ($wasSkillGapAsk) {
                    return $this->sseComplete($this->answerProjectSkillGap(trim($message)), 'faq');
                }
            }
        }

        // Tier 3 — Ollama (streaming SSE)
        $user     = $request->user();
        $employee = $user->employee;
        $name     = $employee ? trim($employee->first_name . ' ' . $employee->last_name) : $user->email;

        $systemContent = self::SYSTEM . "\n\nCurrent user: {$name} | Role: {$user->role}";

        if ($clarify) {
            $systemContent .= "\n\nIMPORTANT: L'utilisateur n'était pas satisfait de la réponse précédente. Ne réponds PAS à la question. Pose exactement 2 à 3 questions courtes et ciblées pour mieux comprendre ce qu'il cherche. Réponds en liste numérotée. Rien d'autre.";
        }

        $learnedContext = $this->getRelevantLearned($message);
        if ($learnedContext) {
            $systemContent .= "\n\n**Connaissances apprises des conversations précédentes (utilise-les si pertinentes) :**\n" . $learnedContext;
        }

        $messages = array_merge(
            [['role' => 'system', 'content' => $systemContent]],
            $request->input('history', []),
            [['role' => 'user', 'content' => $message]]
        );

        $heavy = $clarify
              || $modelOverride === 'heavy'
              || ($modelOverride !== 'light' && $this->isComplexQuestion($message));

    }
