<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Department;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\Skill;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class AnalysisController extends Controller
{
    public function skillsMatrix(): JsonResponse
    {
        $data = DB::select('SELECT * FROM view_skills_matrix');
        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => $data]);
    }

    public function skillsMatrixByDepartment(int $departmentId): JsonResponse
    {
        Department::findOrFail($departmentId);
        $data = DB::select('SELECT * FROM view_skills_matrix WHERE department_name = (SELECT name FROM department WHERE id = ?)', [$departmentId]);
        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => $data]);
    }

    /**
     * Candidats pour un projet — endpoint unifié.
     * ?mode=member       tri composite (60% skill + 40% dispo)  [défaut]
     * ?mode=replacement  tri skill_match_pct DESC + allocation ASC + filtre min_score
     * ?min_score=N       seuil skill_match_pct (ignoré en mode member)
     */
    public function candidates(Request $request, int $projectId): JsonResponse
    {
        Project::findOrFail($projectId);

        $mode     = $request->query('mode', 'member') === 'replacement' ? 'replacement' : 'member';
        $minScore = $mode === 'replacement' ? max(0, min(100, (int) $request->query('min_score', 50))) : 0;
        $orderBy  = $mode === 'replacement'
            ? 'skill_match_pct DESC, total_allocation_pct ASC'
            : 'composite_score DESC, employee_name ASC';

        $data = DB::select("
            SELECT
                e.id                                                                                   AS employee_id,
                CONCAT(e.first_name, ' ', e.last_name)                                                AS employee_name,
                e.job_title,
                d.name                                                                                 AS department_name,
                COUNT(ps.skill_id)                                                                     AS required_skills_count,
                SUM(CASE WHEN vsm.current_level IS NOT NULL
                          AND vsm.current_level >= ps.required_level THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)               AS matched_skills_count,
                ROUND(
                    SUM(CASE WHEN vsm.current_level IS NOT NULL
                              AND vsm.current_level >= ps.required_level THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                    / COUNT(ps.skill_id) * 100
                , 2)                                                                                   AS skill_match_pct,
                COALESCE(alloc.total_allocation_pct, 0)                                                AS total_allocation_pct,
                COALESCE(alloc.active_projects_count, 0)                                               AS active_projects_count,
                ROUND(
                    SUM(CASE WHEN vsm.current_level IS NOT NULL
                              AND vsm.current_level >= ps.required_level THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                    / COUNT(ps.skill_id) * 100 * 0.6
                    + GREATEST(0, 100 - COALESCE(alloc.total_allocation_pct, 0)) * 0.4
                , 0)                                                                                   AS composite_score
            FROM employee e
            JOIN department d ON d.id = e.department_id
            JOIN project_skill ps ON ps.project_id = ?
            LEFT JOIN view_skills_matrix vsm ON vsm.skill_id = ps.skill_id AND vsm.employee_id = e.id
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT employee_id,
                       SUM(allocation_pct) AS total_allocation_pct,
                       COUNT(id)           AS active_projects_count
                FROM project_team WHERE left_at IS NULL GROUP BY employee_id
            ) alloc ON alloc.employee_id = e.id
            WHERE e.is_active = 1
              AND e.id NOT IN (
                  SELECT employee_id FROM project_team WHERE project_id = ? AND left_at IS NULL
              )
            GROUP BY e.id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.job_title, d.name,
                     alloc.total_allocation_pct, alloc.active_projects_count
            HAVING skill_match_pct >= ?
            ORDER BY {$orderBy}
        ", [$projectId, $projectId, $minScore]);

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'data'   => [
                'project_id' => $projectId,
                'mode'       => $mode,
                'min_score'  => $minScore,
                'total'      => count($data),
                'candidates' => $data,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function employeesWithSkill(Request $request, int $skillId): JsonResponse
    {
        Skill::findOrFail($skillId);
        $minLevel = min(5, max(1, (int) $request->query('min_level', 1)));

        $data = DB::select(
            'SELECT * FROM view_skills_matrix WHERE skill_id = ? AND current_level >= ?',
            [$skillId, $minLevel]
        );

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'data'   => [
                'skill_id'  => $skillId,
                'min_level' => $minLevel,
                'total'     => count($data),
                'employees' => $data,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function employeeWorkloads(): JsonResponse
    {
        $data = DB::select('
            SELECT
                e.id AS employee_id,
                CONCAT(e.first_name, " ", e.last_name) AS employee_name,
                e.job_title,
                COUNT(pt.id) AS active_projects_count,
                COALESCE(SUM(pt.allocation_pct), 0) AS total_allocation_pct
            FROM employee e
            LEFT JOIN project_team pt ON pt.employee_id = e.id AND pt.left_at IS NULL
            WHERE e.is_active = 1
            GROUP BY e.id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.job_title
            ORDER BY total_allocation_pct DESC
        ');

        return response()->json(['status' => 'success', 'data' => $data]);
    }

    public function compareEmployeeWithProject(Request $request, int $employeeId, int $projectId): JsonResponse
    {
        Employee::findOrFail($employeeId);
        Project::findOrFail($projectId);

        $outgoingId = $request->query('outgoing_id') ? (int) $request->query('outgoing_id') : null;

        // ── Mode simulation post-remplacement ────────────────────────────────────
        if ($outgoingId) {
            $rows = DB::select('
                SELECT
                    ps.skill_id,
                    s.name                                                                       AS skill_name,
                    sc.name                                                                      AS category_name,
                    ps.required_level,
                    ps.is_critical,

                    -- Membre sortant
                    COALESCE(outg.current_level, 0)                                              AS outgoing_level,
                    CASE WHEN COALESCE(outg.current_level, 0) >= ps.required_level THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS outgoing_matches,

                    -- Candidat
                    COALESCE(cand.current_level, 0)                                              AS candidate_level,
                    CASE WHEN COALESCE(cand.current_level, 0) >= ps.required_level THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS candidate_matches,

                    -- Meilleur niveau équipe restante (hors sortant)
                    COALESCE(team.best_level, 0)                                                 AS team_best_level,
                    CASE WHEN COALESCE(team.best_level, 0) >= ps.required_level THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS team_already_covers,
                    COALESCE(team.covered_by, NULL)                                              AS team_covered_by,

                    -- Couvert après remplacement (candidat OU équipe restante)
                    CASE WHEN
                        COALESCE(cand.current_level, 0) >= ps.required_level
                        OR COALESCE(team.best_level, 0) >= ps.required_level
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END                                                            AS covered_after_replacement

                FROM project_skill ps
                JOIN skill s ON s.id = ps.skill_id
                LEFT JOIN skill_category sc ON sc.id = s.category_id
                LEFT JOIN view_skills_matrix cand ON cand.skill_id = ps.skill_id AND cand.employee_id = ?
                LEFT JOIN view_skills_matrix outg ON outg.skill_id = ps.skill_id AND outg.employee_id = ?
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT vsm2.skill_id,
                           MAX(vsm2.current_level) AS best_level,
                           GROUP_CONCAT(
                               CONCAT(e2.first_name, " ", e2.last_name, " (niv.", vsm2.current_level, ")")
                               ORDER BY vsm2.current_level DESC
                               SEPARATOR ", "
                           ) AS covered_by
                    FROM project_team pt2
                    JOIN employee e2     ON e2.id = pt2.employee_id
                    JOIN view_skills_matrix vsm2 ON vsm2.employee_id = pt2.employee_id
                    WHERE pt2.project_id = ? AND pt2.left_at IS NULL AND pt2.employee_id != ?
                    GROUP BY vsm2.skill_id
                ) team ON team.skill_id = ps.skill_id
                WHERE ps.project_id = ?
                ORDER BY covered_after_replacement ASC, ps.is_critical DESC, s.name ASC
            ', [$employeeId, $outgoingId, $projectId, $outgoingId, $projectId]);

            $total        = count($rows);
            $covered      = array_sum(array_column($rows, 'covered_after_replacement'));
            $candMatches  = array_sum(array_column($rows, 'candidate_matches'));
            $teamCovers   = array_sum(array_column($rows, 'team_already_covers'));
            $gaps         = $total - $covered;
            $score        = $total > 0 ? round($covered / $total * 100, 2) : 0.0;

            return response()->json([
                'status' => 'success',
                'data'   => [
                    'mode'              => 'replacement',
                    'employee_id'       => $employeeId,
                    'project_id'        => $projectId,
                    'outgoing_id'       => $outgoingId,
                    'total_required'    => $total,
                    'total_covered'     => $covered,
                    'candidate_matches' => $candMatches,
                    'team_covers'       => $teamCovers,
                    'gaps'              => $gaps,
                    'match_score_pct'   => $score,
                    'skills'            => $rows,
                ],
            ]);
        }

        // ── Mode simple (candidat vs projet) ────────────────────────────────────
        $comparison = DB::select('
            SELECT
                ps.skill_id,
                s.name AS skill_name,
                sc.name AS category_name,
                ps.required_level,
                ps.is_critical,
                COALESCE(vsm.current_level, 0) AS employee_level,
                CASE WHEN COALESCE(vsm.current_level, 0) >= ps.required_level THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_matched
            FROM project_skill ps
            JOIN skill s ON s.id = ps.skill_id
            LEFT JOIN skill_category sc ON sc.id = s.category_id
            LEFT JOIN view_skills_matrix vsm ON vsm.skill_id = ps.skill_id AND vsm.employee_id = ?
            WHERE ps.project_id = ?
        ', [$employeeId, $projectId]);

        $totalRequired = count($comparison);
        $totalMatched  = array_sum(array_column($comparison, 'is_matched'));
        $matchScore    = $totalRequired > 0 ? round(($totalMatched / $totalRequired) * 100, 2) : 0.0;

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'success',
            'data'   => [
                'mode'            => 'simple',
                'employee_id'     => $employeeId,
                'project_id'      => $projectId,
                'total_required'  => $totalRequired,
                'total_matched'   => $totalMatched,
                'match_score_pct' => $matchScore,
                'skills'          => $comparison,
            ],
        ]);
    }
}
